seo.title: Short, Sharp Help for Complex Projects | McCate & Company
seo.description: Quick scans, decision sparring and short improvement sprints for spatial development and innovation projects. People at the center. Netherlands and Sweden.

hero.intro: Quick scans, decision sparring and short improvement sprints for spatial development and innovation. Decisions are made by people. We start there.

statement: Most projects do not stall on knowledge. They stall on unclear choices and people who are not yet aligned. We find the next decision and make it easy to take.

services.title: Quick scan
services.text: One to two weeks. Where does it stall, what fixes the most, and what do you do first?

services.title: Decision sparring
services.text: A sounding board for directors and teams facing hard choices, with an eye for both process and people.

services.title: Improvement sprint
services.text: A few weeks, a clear goal, then handover. Interim leadership without months of operations.

mission: Decisions are made by people. We start there, with trust, clear language and connection at the heart of the process.
cta: Tell us where your project is stuck. We reply in plain language.
